book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.name: The White Ravens guide
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.tooltip: Everything worth knowing before you start.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.glowna.name: The White Ravens guide
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.start.logow:
Before you play, you set a password here. It is what holds your name — nobody else can log in as you.\
\
**First time**

- [#](1F4E79)/auth register password password[#]()

**Every time after**

- [#](1F4E79)/auth login password[#]()

Until you log in you cannot move or break anything. That is not lag — it is what keeps your name yours.\
\
[#](8B2500)Nobody can recover the password for you.[#]() If you lose it, ask staff.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.start.komen:
- [#](1F4E79)/sethome name[#]() — set a home
- [#](1F4E79)/home name[#]() — return to it
- [#](1F4E79)/back[#]() — return where you were
- [#](1F4E79)/rtp[#]() — a random spot in the wild

How many homes you may keep depends on your rank — one to three.\
\
There is no teleport to another player and none back to spawn. The rest of the world you reach by waystone.

Stone tools, bread and this book arrive on their own: on your first join and after every death.\
\
Need them sooner — [#](1F4E79)/trigger rc_kit[#](), once every half hour.\
\
[#](8B2500)Do it with room in your inventory.[#]() The kit rebuilds it, and whatever does not fit drops at your feet.
Your rank shows in front of your name.\
\
You can set a nickname with [#](1F4E79)/nick[#]() if your rank allows it.

Do not answer in kind — report it. [#](1F4E79)/report name reason[#]() reaches staff at once, with your name attached.\
\
Every report and every staff decision is written down. Nobody is punished off the record.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.dzialki.cla:
Open the mod's map with [#](1F4E79)'[#]() and claim the chunk you are standing in.\
\
Claimed ground is yours: no stranger places or breaks a block in it, opens a chest, or kills your animals.\
\
How many chunks you may claim depends on your rank.

Claims are drawn on Xaero's minimap and world map — yours in green, other people's in their own colour.\
\
Nothing to switch on; the mods know each other.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.dzialki.for: Farms that run while you are away

A claimed chunk can be marked forceloaded — the server keeps it loaded even with nobody there. That is the only way a farm runs while you are offline.\
\
There are no craftable chunk loaders here. The forceload budget comes with your rank, which keeps the server load predictable.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.dzialki.par:
Create a party, invite your friends, then grant the party access to your claims. You build together and the rest of the server still cannot get in.

- [#](1F4E79)/openpac-parties create name[#]()
- [#](1F4E79)/openpac-parties invite nick[#]()
- [#](1F4E79)/opm message[#]() — party chat
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.dzialki.ran:
Your rank sets how many chunks you may claim, how many of them stay loaded, and how many homes you get:

- **Nowy** — 4 chunks, 1 home
- **Gracz** — 6 chunks, 2 forceload, 2 homes
- **Obywatel** — 8 chunks, 4 forceload, 3 homes
- **Mistrz** — 12 chunks, 8 forceload, 3 homes

Homes stop at three for everyone. Mistrz pays for ground, not for shortcuts across the map.

Ranks are not sold for real money and never will be — Mojang forbids it, and it would make for a worse server anyway.\
\
You move up by playing and by what you leave behind. A rank can also be paid for in game with staff; a person grants it, not a machine.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.handel.skle: Trading without waiting for each other

Craft a shop block from 4 planks, wool and an iron ingot. Put it on or beside a chest and set what you sell and for what.\
\
There is no currency — you trade item for item. Diamonds are what people count in here.\
\
You can buy at any shop on the server, on other people's claims and at spawn too.

Put the shop on your own claim.\
\
[#](8B2500)It sells out of the chest you point it at.[#]() Do not attach it to a chest you would mind emptying.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.handel.ways: Fast travel you have to find first

This is the andesite one — there are several kinds and they all work the same.\
\
Your first arrives as a gift with the Obywatel rank.

A waystone is a stone marker standing in the world. Click one to discover it, and from then on you can jump to it from any other.\
\
[#](8B2500)Waystones cannot be crafted.[#]() You find them in villages, buy them at the admin shop, and get one as a gift on reaching Obywatel.\
\
Sharestones and scrolls you do make yourself, and they are how you build a network around what you got.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.sprzet.plec:
The standard one. Worn on your back and visible on your character.\
\
You upgrade it in steps: more room, fluid tanks, a sleeping bag.

Traveler's Backpack is worn on your back and shows on your character. You upgrade it in steps, it holds fluids, and with the sleeping bag out it sets your spawn.\
\
On death it goes into your grave with everything else — nothing spills.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.sprzet.grob: Dying does not cost you your gear

When you die your gear does not lie on the ground — a grave appears. Come back and click it to take everything at once.

- [#](1F4E79)/graves list[#]() — your graves

The grave is yours; no stranger opens it.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.sprzet.drze: A whole tree in one cut

Cut the bottom log and the whole tree comes down with it. Nothing to install or switch on — it runs on the server.\
\
Hold sneak to chop the ordinary way, block by block.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.sprzet.shad: Turning them on and what to pick

The pack ships two shaders and Iris to run them. Switch them on in [#](1F4E79)Options → Video → Shaders[#]().

- **Reimagined** — the default. Fine light and water, and the world still looks like Minecraft.
- **Unbound** — stronger, closer to realism. It costs more frames.

Drop the render distance first, shaders second. The rest of the tuning is in the pack and needs no setting up — Sodium, Lithium and a few more.

- [#](1F4E79)F3[#]() — a readable debug screen
- [#](1F4E79)C[#]() — zoom
